hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Hashtags to benchmark, with or without #, for example igcse, satmath, apcalculus, ibmaths.

regions.title: Countries of the videos
regions.description: Optional two-letter country codes (AE, SA, QA, GB, US). Only videos TikTok says were posted from these countries are used. Leave empty for all countries.

maxVideosPerHashtag.title: Videos to use per hashtag
maxVideosPerHashtag.description: Upper limit of videos used for each hashtag's benchmark (1-200). The number actually found depends on what search returns.

recentDays.title: Only videos from the last (days)
recentDays.description: Older videos are left out of the benchmark. Search engines tend to return older videos, so the default is a year; lower it for a fresher but smaller sample (the benchmark row shows how many videos were dropped as too old).

minVideosForBenchmark.title: Videos needed for a full benchmark
minVideosForBenchmark.description: Below this number the benchmark row says thin_sample, so you know it is only a rough guide.

maxSearchPages.title: Search result pages per wording
maxSearchPages.description: How many result pages are read for each way of asking.

includeVideos.title: Add one row per video
includeVideos.description: Adds the videos behind the benchmark (recordType video) with views, likes, comments, shares, date and country.

delayBetweenVideosMs.title: Delay between video reads (ms)
delayBetweenVideosMs.description: Pause after each video page, per worker.

concurrency.title: Video pages read at the same time

maxCreatorsToRead.title: Creators whose recent videos are read
maxCreatorsToRead.description: The creators found by the search are also asked for their recent videos (TikTok's public creator embed), and those that carry the hashtag are added. 0 turns this off. This is what makes the sample larger and fresher.

delayBetweenCreatorsMs.title: Delay between creators (ms)
delayBetweenCreatorsMs.description: Pause after each creator's embed page.
